steps.title: A01/A17: manual external handler, compact context and ordered content
The current handler starts through the offered workflow
A02: request information records the exact requester and recipient
A09: one Publish performs a real preflight without returning information or starting AI
A02: the receiving form returns the exact saved information request
A03/A12: a comment prepares a result draft only after an explicit action
A07/A12: author discussion remains available and source-comment changes preserve the delivery
A04: initiator returns the exact submission to its explicitly selected actual author
A04: resubmission creates a new exact result and retains the first decision
A05/A15/A16: accept the exact result from the same source issue without completing the ordinary parent
A12/A17: retained results, exact source-comment anchors and restored account scroll
